scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@balance/core && npm run build --workspace=@balance/sync-client
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=client && rm -rf server/client-dist && cp -R client/dist server/client-dist
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.verify: npm run hygiene && npm run abi:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run test:hygiene && npm run test --workspace=@balance/core && npm run test --workspace=@balance/sync-client && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=balance-desktop
scripts.dist: npm run notices && npm run build && npm run dist --workspace=balance-desktop && npm run abi
